queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'CrystalDiskMark %' AND publisher = 'Crystal Dew World';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'CrystalDiskMark %' AND publisher = 'Crystal Dew World' AND version_compare(version, '9.0.3') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'crystaldiskmark.exe');
